articles.title: Iran SHUTS DOOR On Asim Munir's 'Nuclear Proposal'; IRGC's Rezaei's 'Cold' Embrace Goes Viral
articles.description: Pakistan’s most powerful man flew to Tehran with a special delivery from Donald Trump. The parcel contained a US proposal: nuclear inspections, access to around six billion dollars in restricted Iranian funds and possible financial relief. Iran’s response was less “welcome to Tehran” and more “please take this message back.” Mohsen Rezaei reportedly made the red line clear: not one particle of enriched uranium will leave Iran. Munir’s greeting looked formal and chilly. A Qatari delegation reportedly followed and left without a breakthrough. Oil prices briefly celebrated the rumour of a deal. Then Iran rejected the core demand. Pakistan wanted to be the diplomatic bridge. Instead, Munir looked like a postman whose delivery was refused at the door.
